core_concept: An intimate, sophisticated two-player crossword experience connecting Italy and Japan. The UI uses warm paper textures, editorial typography, and clear, distinct player colors to create a cozy, collaborative environment. The layout is structured and grid-forward, maximizing the puzzle space while maintaining elegance.

headings.usage: Headers, landing page title, victory screens. Gives an editorial, classic newspaper feel.

body.usage: UI elements, clue lists, buttons, room codes.

mono.usage: Grid cell letters, cell numbers, room codes.

landing_screen.structure: Split screen or centered card on a warm paper background. Left/Top: Emotional hero image and classic serif title ('Cruciverba Insieme'). Right/Bottom: Elegant join form.
landing_screen.components: Shadcn inputs (customized with warm borders, no default blue focus rings), pill-shaped submit buttons.

game_screen.desktop: Two-column bento-style layout. Left column (grid-cols-8): The crossword grid, centered with breathing room. Right column (grid-cols-4): Sticky clue panel split into 'Orizzontali' (Across) and 'Verticali' (Down), plus header with player presence.
game_screen.mobile: Mobile-first vertical stack. Top sticky header (player presence). Middle: The crossword grid (zoomable/pannable or perfectly sized). Bottom: Floating active clue, with a drawer or scrollable list for all clues.
game_screen.navigation: Header must have a solid background (bg-[#F9F6F0]) with bottom border. No transparent headers.

rules: Use CSS Grid for the board. Aspect ratio must be square.
Numbers: Absolute positioned top-left, text-[0.5rem] JetBrains Mono.
Letters: Centered, uppercase, text-xl to text-2xl JetBrains Mono.
Focus state: Must use the specific player's color for border and a subtle background tint.
Presence: Show a small colored dot or triangle in the top-right corner of the cell the other player is currently focused on.
Active clue gets a left border highlight matching the active player's color and a subtle background tint.
Hover state on clues should subtly highlight the corresponding cells in the grid.
Inputs: bg-transparent, border-b-2 (or full rounded border with 1px border-[#D6CEC2]).

micro_interactions: Cell input: Subtle pop (scale 1.1 to 1.0) when a letter is typed.
Clue switch: Smooth scroll within the clue list when moving to a new word on the grid.
Player join: Avatar slides in from the top right with a subtle spring animation.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform), never 'transition: all'.

hero_background.description: White ceramic mug with coffee on a wooden table, used for landing page hero or welcome screen to set a warm, cozy Italian/morning vibe.

texture_overlay.description: Crumpled beige parchment paper. Use as a very low opacity (5-10%) mix-blend-multiply background overlay for the app surface to kill the 'digital flatness'.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text, especially clues and grid letters, meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast against the warm backgrounds. Do not use pure gray; tint grays with warmth.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full arrow-key navigation within the grid. Pressing space or clicking toggles Across/Down direction.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to all interactive elements. Examples: data-testid='room-code-input', data-testid='join-button', data-testid='grid-cell-0-0', data-testid='clue-across-1'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, JetBrains Mono.
Implement the UI exclusively in Italian as requested.
For the real-time presence, simulate or implement logic so Player 1 and Player 2 have distinct cursor/cell colors (Slate/Indigo for P1, Terracotta for P2).
Use Lucide-react for icons (e.g., users, share, check, arrow-right).
DO NOT use generic centered box layouts for the game screen. Use the full viewport elegantly.
Ensure the header background is solid (bg-[#F9F6F0]), not transparent.

universal_guidelines.spacing: Use 2x-3x more spacing than typical defaults (p-6, p-8, p-12).
universal_guidelines.borders: Use subtle colored borders (1px) rather than heavy drop shadows to create depth in the flat editorial style.
universal_guidelines.interactions: Ensure every button and interactive element has explicit hover and focus states with adequate contrast.
